primaryQuery: Home Assistant vacuum when nobody home
readerQuestion: How can Home Assistant start my existing robot vacuum only after everyone leaves, avoid repeated starts, and send it home if someone returns?
selectedBecause: A September 28, 2026 Reddit discussion independently raises away-only cleaning, a daily limit, daytime hours and return-to-dock behavior; older separate Community questions show the same household problem and a missed second-person departure. Exact-query results include the current official minimal zone/start example and extensive device-specific configurations. The useful gap is one bounded, documented recipe with explicit person validity checks, a guest/pet pause, a persisted date for at most one start attempt per day, restart re-evaluation, harmless notification rehearsal and an honest arrival-policy caveat. This extends an existing robot rather than publishing another buying guide. Community posts establish interest, not search volume.

searchReview.query: Home Assistant vacuum when nobody home
searchReview.intent: Configure an already integrated vacuum to start only when the household is away, at sensible hours, with no repeated departures causing repeated starts.
searchReview.resultGap: The official start-action example answers the basic trigger but omits a daily attempt record, invalid person states, guest/pet permission, restart re-evaluation and a safe dry run. Community results show single-person and zone-attribute mistakes. The custom example combines those boundaries and explicitly says docking on arrival also interrupts manual cleaning under an away-only policy. Direct Google was blocked by HTTP 429; current exact-query web results were available and reviewed, without ranking/volume claims.

existingCoverage.decision: Inventoried every canonical title and available topic-brief reader question, read closest page bodies, schedule and ownership maps. Vacuum owner compares hardware/control paths and only mentions away cleaning; Person owner diagnoses presence updates; house modes owns shared household state; actionable notifications owns confirmation transport. The new page owns one operational vacuum recipe, leaving all titles/URLs stable. Pre-draft SEO intent gate passed. Commercial owner /home-automation-kit/ matches coordinated local routines. Read schedule-selected September 21 performance/inspection/recovery, July causal review and analytics contract; JSON-parsed Chart cutoff September 19: September 13-19 3 clicks/212 impressions versus September 6-12 2/205; last 28 days 11/955 versus prior 28 21/2700. September 20-21 are absent, not zero. Recent dimensions only from seo/search-comparison-2026-09-21.json: homepage 3 clicks/22 impressions versus 1/16; Person owner 0/3 versus 0/8; automation-not-firing owner 0/9 versus 0/5; Bluetooth 0/19 versus 0/8. All current clicks accounted for by tarahome/homepage; no blog clicks or non-brand recovery. US 111 to 72 impressions; desktop 176 to 185, mobile 28 to 27, tablet 1 to 0. Page rows sum to 375 versus property Chart 212 because these are different aggregations; visible query rows omit anonymized searches. Neither tiny rows nor cumulative three-month tables justify volume or a pivot. September 21 inspections: IKEA, laundry and Spokane indexed; trash and vacation discovered but not indexed. These are dated observations, not live October status; no September 15 exclusions repeated as current. July losses span devices, countries and changed/unchanged HTML; no platform culprit or title rollback remedy proven. Separate refresh tasks only: recovery review priorities remain IKEA, Bluetooth, leak-sensor and doorbell owners with real device evidence when available; existing vacuum buying page has dated model recommendations that deserve their own exact-model review, not another buying URL. Preserve PARASOLL/VALLHORN Zigbee facts and ownership regardless of indexing. No private analytics, GA4 event totals, inquiry data, strategy changes or old-article edits used. One-per-day limit unchanged; publication/indexing requests are not indexing or recovery proof.
